qualifications: Three separate sequential 700-tic sprite/model pairs, one visible species each and an offscreen Mandinga control. Queue-present intervals are not GPU/display timing or repeatability/campaign/crowd acceptance.
Simplified candidate anatomy, UV seams, garment fit and articulation require author review. No exact-reference-sculpt or final-art acceptance claim.
Fixed reference outfits have editable material/body groups; they are not runtime interchangeable equipment. #458/#459 modular body/equipment work remains unfinished.
Neutral art height fits current provisional stats. Catalogue metric sizes are unapproved, and moving/lying art can exceed collision Radius.
No new actor states, saved fields, AI scans, balance values, loot rules or campaign spawns.
Original CATALOGUE/AUTHORING art flags remain historical snapshots; specific MODELDEF bindings and ASSETS describe current production coverage.
Original generated image outputs and both atlas versions are preserved; no raster postprocessing.
No PK3, WAD, executable, DLL, development IWAD or save is committed.
Native screen footprints differ: the new models fit the provisional standing Height while the inherited Mandinga sprite art is visibly taller. These views do not establish equal-pixel render costs.
